summary: Backend-only regression test after extracting notifyInviteAccepted from teamController.ts into backend/controller/team/teamNotifications.ts. All 6 tests PASS end-to-end against the live preview backend: owner login, team invite creation (unique plus-addressed email), invite info lookup, /api/team/accept public flow, owner in-app notification (type=team_member_joined with 'accepted your invite and joined' message), team.accept audit row on /api/team/activity, and full cleanup (DELETE /api/team/members/<id> for each newly created member with verification that no non-revoked test members remain). The extracted notifyInviteAccepted module fires correctly (in-app notification + audit row confirmed; outbound email suppressed via DISABLE_OUTBOUND_EMAIL as expected in preview).
critical_code_review_comments: teamNotifications.ts is clean: wraps each company in try/catch so accept flow never fails due to notification errors; correctly skips notifying the joiner themselves (ownerId === memberUserId); email fired with `void` so promise rejections won't crash. Good.
Import path in teamController.ts './team/teamNotifications' is consistent with the new module location.
Minor: consider adding a unit test that mocks companyModel to assert notifyInviteAccepted skips when ownerId == memberUserId — currently only covered implicitly.
